Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BHARAT PETROLEUM CORPORATION LIMITED LPG Bottling Plant Piyala Scope of Work Venue Hire and Associated Arrangements for LPG Operations and Sales Me et The contractor shall provide the conference venue and associated arrangements described below for the o ne-day LPG Operations and Sales Meet. 1 Event duration and coordination

The service duration shall be one event day. The date, venue location and programme timings shall be con firmed by the BPCL Officer-in-Charge. The contractor shall obtain BPCL approval of the proposed venue, ro om layout, artwork and delivery schedule before making the arrangements. Coordinate venue access and setup with BPCL, the venue representative and the agencies providing other event services. All arrangements shall be ready for inspection before the programme starts, with sufficient access time for installation and testing of separately hired equipment. 2 Schedule of services S No Description Qty Unit 1 Conference venue hire 1 Day 2 Printed backdrop and signage 1 Job 3 Officer stationery kits 20 Sets 4 Performance licences IPRS and PPL 1 Day 3 Conference venue hire Provide one clean, air-conditioned meeting room for one day and the approved meeting layout. Include bas ic venue utilities such as normal room lighting, available electrical supply points, functioning air-conditioni ng, access to washrooms and routine venue housekeeping. Identify the proposed venue, room capacity and layout in the offer. Confirm the availability and arrangeme nt of meeting furniture with BPCL before finalising the venue. Keep access routes clear and provide suitabl e space for the separately arranged presentation platform, audiovisual equipment and backdrop. Audiovis ual equipment and catering are excluded from venue hire. 4 Printed backdrop and signage Provide one printed backdrop and one welcome board, including artwork preparation, printing, transportati on, fixing and removal after the event. Obtain BPCL approval of the content, logo use, dimensions, material and installation positions before printing. Ensure clear text, correct spelling, good print quality an d secure fixing without damaging venue property. LED display is excluded from this item. 5 Officer stationery kits Supply 20 complete stationery kits, each containing one folder, one writing pad and one pen. Submit the pr oposed kit or product details for BPCL approval before supply. Deliver clean, usable kits at the venue befor e the programme, with one kit for each officer. Replace incomplete or defective kits before distribution; no additional branding or contents shall be introduced without approval. 6 Performance licences Arrange the performance licences identified in the estimate as IPRS and PPL for the one-day event, as appli cable to the activities and content approved by BPCL. Before the event, confirm the planned use of music o r other licensed content with BPCL and the venue representative, and verify whether any existing venue a uthorisations cover that use. Where required, obtain the applicable licences for the approved event date, venue and activities before th e relevant content is used. Submit copies of the licences or authorisations and supporting fee receipts to B PCL. Do not assume that venue hire includes these permissions. Any claimed existing coverage or non-app

licability shall be supported with documentation and brought to BPCL for confirmation before finalising the arrangements. 7 Contractor responsibilities and safety Provide the personnel, materials, transport, loading and unloading, fixing accessories and supervision requ ired for the included services. Nominate one coordinator to remain available during setup, the programme and clearance. Resolve deficiencies promptly and obtain BPCL approval before changing an approved arra ngement. Follow BPCL and venue instructions and applicable access procedures. Secure the backdrop and welcome b oard; keep emergency exits, walkways and emergency equipment unobstructed. Coordinate electrical req uirements of other event agencies with the venue representative. Protect venue property during fixing and removal and report any damage or unsafe condition to BPCL. 8 Scope boundaries Coordinate interfaces with the agencies engaged separately by BPCL without duplicating their charges. An y additional service or variation shall require prior written approval under the tender terms. 9 Inspection completion and acceptance BPCL shall inspect the arrangements before the event. Acceptance shall require availability of the approve d air-conditioned room and basic utilities, satisfactory installation of one backdrop and one welcome board , delivery of 20 complete stationery kits. After the event, remove the supplied backdrop and signage when permitted by BPCL, clear installation deb ris and hand over the venue in a clean condition. 10 Price coverage and tender conditions Quoted prices shall include all costs required to execute the stated scope, including venue hire and specifi ed utilities, artwork, printing, fixing, stationery, applicable licence fees, manpower, transport and clearanc e. Quote taxes as required in the GeM bid. Payment and other commercial conditions shall be governed by the GeM bid and applicable BPCL tender documents. .
